description: Curated from the completed local research workspace. Certificate and saved report bytes are unchanged; large JSON inputs use lossless gzip. Release 1.1.0 (2026-10-21) added the rank-four follow-up work (level-four zero, Eisenstein family, parity property, independent assessment) under the same conventions; large preserved reports are gzip files listed in reports/compressed-reports.json.
